title: Exact old application refused after N36 cut
question: Can the exact old 66-page intent execute after the N36 native contract change without re-preparing its immutable application?
method: Add only the exact four generated native contract files as a separate physical metadata overlay and invoke managed recovery with the original release/runtime and private answer held. Observe the native authority refusal before any producer claim or inference, then compare the actual producing definition snapshot with the fresh admitted N36 definition.
conclusion: N36 correctly refused the N35 application with SQLSTATE 23514 and release facts require current authenticated re-lowering. The accepted plan requires a newly prepared application. That fresh definition changes implementation_revision and support_contract, and both definitions remain reuse-ineligible. The original 92MB answer is preserved; no application authority was rewritten and no 66-page provider rerun was attempted. Carrying this answer remains blocked by exact producing-material and attempt-only guards.
